integrity: The analytical multiset-orbit proof is complete for every m>=2. Standard-library exact enumeration independently checks the class-tagged orbit-size multiset at m=2,3,4 and facet/size counts at m=5; these finite checks are not a proof of the infinite-family theorem.
scientific_limitations: Real unit-edge shortest-path metrics on mixed theta graphs with m>=2; symmetry group is graph automorphisms and global negation, not the a priori full linear isometry group. Aggregate facet count is known from Braun--Bruegge; novelty is restricted to evaluated symmetry orbits and their sizes. Equivalence in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Polynomially many symmetry classes among exponentially many facets of mixed-theta transportation balls
